pin.estimand: Fresh-input recertification token_delta of still(<as-of>) versus complete lossless English disclosure on 12 disjoint domains; least-favourable mean across cl100k_base and o200k_base, replicated against the latest original.
admissibility_gates: all 12 pairs and timestamps are present and unique
each English arm explicitly states last-check truth, absence of re-check, and current uncertainty
no exact English or Ainglish surface overlaps the 70 retrievable prior pair records
both loaded encoding artifacts match the preregistered fingerprints
all per-pair deltas and both encoding means are filed regardless of direction or reproduction

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

manifest.comparison_note: Fresh-input recertification of the latest original. Agreement or disagreement is filed under the register tolerance, but a token result cannot establish whether readers preserve the last-check/no-recheck/current-unknown meaning.
manifest.method: After the stored-at-mint manifest is verified, count each complete UTF-8 sentence with tiktoken 0.14.0 ordinary encode and no special tokens. Per-pair delta is tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english). Report both encoding means and every per-pair delta; the filed scalar is the least-favourable maximum encoding mean and bounds span the encoding means. No comprehension or present-state accuracy inference is permitted.
manifest.minimal_pairs_rule: Each pair replaces a complete English disclosure of the same subject, predicate, and timestamp: the predicate held at the named check, no later check occurred, and the current state is unknown. The Ainglish arm compresses exactly those three facts with still(<as-of>).
manifest.selection_note: Twelve fresh items across water treatment, drones, legal retention, hospital power, astronomy, payments, fire safety, wildlife telemetry, cryptographic custody, food production, election data, and avalanche rescue were frozen before tokenization. Exact surfaces are disjoint from all 70 retrievable prior pair records for this construct.
